answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The summit counter is kept in pigment and quill exposes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The attacker spends 199 dollars and 17 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
